_doc: ROSTER-SUBTYPE MAP — groundwork for variant-level roster entries (v0.27.x).
Why this exists:
The engine reasons at c-prefix granularity. One c-prefix is one chr
ASSET, and the engine treats it as one roster ENTRY — caps, floors,
tier, flier-status and exclusion are all keyed on the c-prefix.
But a single asset can host several distinct gameplay IDENTITIES:
c5250's chr hosts Horned Warrior, Divine Bird Warrior AND Divine
Beast Warrior — three enemies, one skeleton. This file records those
splits so a later stage can let a subtype carry its own attributes.
THIS FILE ALONE CHANGES NO ENGINE BEHAVIOR. It is data only. The
loader (_roster_subtypes in oops_v3.py) exposes it; nothing consumes
it yet. A c-prefix not listed here remains exactly one roster entry,
identical to today.
Schema — subtypes[c_prefix]:
base_name : the c-prefix's umbrella name (informational).
entries   : ordered list of subtype objects, each with:
subtype       : short stable id, snake_case, unique within the
c-prefix. The eventual roster-entry id is the pair
(c_prefix, subtype).
display_name  : human-facing enemy name.
EXACTLY ONE matcher, mapping the subtype to NpcParam variants:
variant_name  : matches every variant whose variant_name equals
this string. Use when the names already
distinguish the subtypes (the common case).
npc_param_ids : explicit id list. Use when variant_name does NOT
distinguish them — e.g. a winged variant that
shares its ground siblings' name.
attributes    : RESERVED for the next stage (e.g. {"is_flier":
true}). Leave absent until a consumer exists.
Curation note: dev/audit_genuine_variants.py clusters NpcParam rows by
genuine identity (behaviorVariationId, think_param_id // 1000) — its
--variation-report is the intended tool for discovering which c-prefixes
host genuinely distinct sub-identities worth listing here.
Seed: c5250 only — the verified, worked example. Expand deliberately;
a multi-name variant scan flagged ~42 candidate c-prefixes but most
need a per-case judgement call and some need an NpcParam dig.

c6200._note: v0.27.48 (Alaric): added alongside the variant-restrict pin in data/variant_restrict_list.json that drops the 13 c6200-hosted Scarab summon variants (62001000-62005200) and keeps only the two real Gael variants. Phase 1 and Phase 2 Gael are technically two separate NpcParam rows with their own AI / movesets / stats (62000001 P1, 62000000 P2 -- yes the P2 has the lower id, that's how MMV imported them); at random placement time each is a distinct gameplay identity, same shape as the c5250 split above.
